label: General arrangement of an LNG-fuelled ship in side view: engine room aft, fuel preparation room, tank connection space and the fuel tank forward, the bunkering station on the open deck and the vent mast above the deck.

steps.title: 1 · Fuel tank - in a fuel storage hold space or on open deck.
2 · Tank connection space - surrounds all tank connections and tank valves.
3 · Fuel preparation room - pumps, compressors and vaporizers.
4 · Bunkering station - on open deck, where fuel is received.
5 · Vent mast - releases fuel vapour from the relief valves, high above the weather deck.
